args.title: Historical Honeycomb Alert Handling — Dec. 23, 2023–Jan. 1, 2024
args.body:
# Historical Honeycomb Alert Handling

**Coverage period:** December 23, 2023 through January 1, 2024

## Thresholds

Existing Honeycomb alert thresholds remained unchanged during the holiday coverage period. No threshold changes or special holiday sensitivity were introduced.

## Paging

Alerts were routed first to the named engineering on-call owner, Marcus, with Leo Park as backup. The documented on-call path remained the primary response route.

## Escalation

Morgan was involved only when:

- Customer impact was confirmed; or
- The named on-call owner could not be reached after following the documented owner/backup path.

Founders were not treated as a catch-all escalation path. Non-customer-impacting alert noise and routine cleanup could wait until January.

## Quiet-week reporting

If the week remained quiet, or alerts were limited to non-production flaps without confirmed customer impact, the activity was recorded in the Monday digest rather than escalated directly to Morgan. The digest captured relevant alert noise, acknowledgment issues, and any follow-up needed after the break.

The normal operating schedule resumed Tuesday, January 2, 2024.
